attchmntText: B. L. Kashyap and Sons Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
sm_name: B. L. Kashyap and Sons Limited
voiceSummary: B L Kashyap And Sons Limited filed an investor presentation regarding unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Consolidated revenue for Q2 FY 26-27 was Rs. 498.15 crore. Consolidated EBITDA stood at Rs. 40.83 crore. Consolidated profit after tax was Rs. 20.21 crore. Standalone revenue was Rs. 457.80 crore. Standalone profit after tax was Rs. 17.95 crore. The order book as of September 30, 2026, was Rs. 4,647 crore. New project orders worth Rs. 696 crore were awarded during the quarter. The company recognized an exceptional loss of Rs. 21.96 crore in consolidated results. This includes a provision of Rs. 52.50 crore for Right of Recompense settlement. The company plans a capex of Rs. 65 crore for FY 27.

attchmntText: B. L. Kashyap and Sons Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
sm_name: B. L. Kashyap and Sons Limited
voiceSummary: B.L. Kashyap and Sons Limited approved its unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The Board meeting was held on 12th November 2026. Standalone revenue from operations was 45,779.62 lakhs for the quarter, with a profit after tax of 1,795.04 lakhs. Consolidated revenue from operations was 49,815.00 lakhs, with a profit after tax of 2,020.57 lakhs. The company recognized Rs. 52.50 crore as an exceptional item for Rate of Return liability provision. Additionally, Rs. 20.98 crore was recognized under other income due to the write-back of outstanding liabilities. The results are available on the company website and stock exchange portals.

attchmntText: B. L. Kashyap and Sons Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Board comments on fine levied by the Exchange'.
sm_name: B. L. Kashyap and Sons Limited
voiceSummary: B.L. Kashyap and Sons Limited informed the National Stock Exchange of India that its Board of Directors, at a meeting on 12th November 2026, noted non-compliance with Regulation 31 of SEBI Listing Regulations due to a delay in filing the Shareholding Pattern for the quarter ended 30th June 2026. The NSE had issued a notice on 14th August 2026 levying a fine of Rs. 48,000 plus GST of Rs. 8,640, totaling Rs. 56,640. The company submitted a waiver application which was rejected by the NSE. The Board attributed the lapse to an inadvertent oversight where the filing was made with the BSE under the assumption of an integrated mechanism, but was missed on the NSE platform. The Board advised the Secretarial team to exercise utmost care and strengthen internal monitoring mechanisms to prevent recurrence. The company has paid the levied fine.
